candidates.brief: Farm path splitting in two at golden hour: left path back toward a distant city, right path toward a big farm. A BLANK wooden two-arrow signpost stands in the middle.
Dim hall with three large doorways glowing different colours (red crime-city neon, blue war smoke, golden adventure ruins). Doors open, no people. Floor space centre-bottom for Quest (back view).
High aerial of a patchwork farm: fields, barn, silos, paths, a lake. Organised and satisfying. Room for small tractor props.
